title: EduIDE Environment

cluster.description: Must match a file in clusters/. Checked against the cluster's own identity at deploy time.

stack.description: Which control plane the environment runs. java is the Theia Cloud based 2.x stack (chart eduide 2.x, values on top of _base.yaml). go is the EduIDE 3.x Go control plane (chart eduide 3.x, values on top of _base-go.yaml). Omitted means java.

chartVersion.description: Version of the oci://ghcr.io/eduide/charts/eduide chart. 2.x for stack java, 3.x for stack go.

channel.description: release installs the images the chart pins. main marks an environment that follows a floating image tag: on stack java the deploy restarts operator, service and landing page afterwards to force a pull (stack go does not restart anything). pinned is accepted but nothing reads it.

description: Deployment metadata for one environment. Chart configuration lives in values.yaml alongside this file, as a plain Helm values file.
